# Cynorida

> Cynorida is a cybersecurity company. We protect, test and investigate the systems our clients run, through managed detection and response, incident response, threat hunting, penetration testing and red teaming.

We sell security work, not software or accounts: clients keep ownership of their own tools and systems. Every engagement starts with a written scope, offensive testing starts only after signed authorisation, and each finding is reported with its evidence and fix.

## Services

- [Managed detection and response](https://cynorida.com/services/managed-detection-and-response/)
- [Incident response](https://cynorida.com/services/incident-response/)
- [Threat hunting](https://cynorida.com/services/threat-hunting/)
- [Detection engineering](https://cynorida.com/services/detection-engineering/)
- [Penetration testing](https://cynorida.com/services/penetration-testing/)
- [Red teaming](https://cynorida.com/services/red-teaming/)
